title: Astra Portal Bridge
description: Dials out to astra's portal MCP server so an LLM client (Claude Code / Claude Desktop) can search and create against this world. It can search the compendium and world entities, import statblocks, drop tokens, author actors, items, effects and spells with rule elements, scene lights, conditions, macros and journals, and update or delete documents. Player keys get a read-only subset: query-party, query-player, query-item and query-rolls.
